name: Pre-rendered park sim
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a GAME SPRITE PRODUCTION SHEET, landscape, heading '01  Pre-rendered park sim'. This must look like actual game sprites in a modern sharper successor to RollerCoaster Tycoon, NOT a large illustrated character portrait or realistic concept painting. Elevated orthographic camera looking down at 55 degrees. Character: a slender teenage neighborhood groundskeeper in an ocean-blue uniform polo and charcoal shorts, normal small head, no doll joints, no chibi. Arrange eight directions of the SAME small person in a wide horizontal strip, each at roughly 100 image pixels high, including their scythe. Above this strip show a single 4x enlarged VIEW FROM THE SAME OVERHEAD GAME CAMERA of the person carefully sweeping a scythe, NOT eye-level portrait. At right a small matching used compact pickup with rake, fuel can, mower in bed from the same game camera. Software-rendered fine material shading, broad readable forms, smooth refined geometry and minimal 1-pixel grain, no ink outlines, no chunky voxels, no glossy toy. Simple neutral grey-green background. An actual production-ready small game-character feel with no dramatic facial portrait, no large facial eyes, no manga, no paper texture. Small grass patch only under one working sprite, no landscape illustration. Clearly distinct from painterly concept art.

name: Fine pixel craft
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A true pixel-art GAME SPRITE SHEET with heading '03  Fine pixel craft'. Every edge and color area must be formed from plainly visible SQUARE PIXEL CLUSTERS, enlarged with nearest-neighbor. NO smooth painterly illustration, no brush grain, no anti-aliased edges, no soft gradients. Think a carefully drawn 64x96-pixel character sprite enlarged 5 times to show the grid, like high-resolution 1990s park-simulation character art made sharper. One full-body slender teenage groundskeeper carrying a scythe, viewed from a high overhead 50-degree angle, wearing a turquoise T-shirt and tan work trousers, small natural head, no chibi or doll joints. At right show four small facing directions of this same character at native game scale, plus a compact utilitarian pickup with a rake, fuel can and mower in its bed rendered in the SAME very explicit square-pixel technique. Limit to 32 harmonious earthy colors; shade with broad pixel clusters and very sparse dithering; no dark exterior contour. Place on flat pale sage background. No front-facing anime portrait, no watercolor/pencil illustration, no parchment. Distinct visible digital pixel geometry is mandatory.
